applications.notes: Print panel 400 x 1000 mm with 3 mm bleed (page 406 x 1006). Reference: faithful reproduction in source colours (drifted blues #1F4383 for header, bars, text and QR plate; token blue #0B3D8A in the badges; rich black as #000000), ArialMT (MOBIAN) outlined, the header edge shading rebuilt as vector gradient with the exact axis and curve of the PDF, QR modules from the clip path. Template: token colours only (#1A3580 all blues, #1D1D1B text), live Ubuntu text, every variable has data-variable (title-<bar>, day-N, hours-N, label-N, price-N, location-name, phone, terms-url), QR as placeholder group inside the navy plate (variable qr-target, example https://parkingyou.nl/nl/locaties/rotterdam/parking-maashaven/id=129). Bars run through the bleed; header band comp includes its own bleed. OPEN: terms URL. The print has www.parkingyou.nl/algemene-voorwaarden, the handbook (3.6) www.parkingyou.nl/nl/algemene-voorwaarden; the print value is kept as the variable value, the owner decides which one is correct. Positions: page mm minus 3 mm trim offset (the Phase 1 note 'text starts at 14.8 mm' is the page coordinate: 11.8 mm from the trim edge). The inverted QR (white on navy) may fail on some scanners; the sample decodes with zxing. Layout fact: bars 35.15 mm high, rows pitch 21.17 mm (1.2 x 17.64 mm).

applications.notes: 800 x 250 mm trim, 10 mm bleed (page 820 x 270). Navy stadium with elliptical ends (rx 133.3, ry 125 mm); the template draws one navy shape into the bleed (rx 143.3, ry 135 mm, the 10 mm offset of the trim shape; the source bleed shape is 820 x 273.5 mm and sticks 1.7 mm out of the page). Library check: py-atom-picto-car matches the print car (same proportion, scale 6.79) and py-atom-arrow-up-circle matches the print circle and arrow (scale 1.268, arrow share 0.706). The library arc py-comp-route-module-separator has the same shape but would print with a 5.3 mm stroke instead of 3.0 mm, so the print arc is extracted as the variant py-comp-route-module-separator-uitrit (py-atom-shape-separator-arc is the handbook illustration in grey and navy, not the aqua arc). Uit is live Ubuntu Bold 167.84 mm, white (fitted by overlay, width and height agree). Blue in the source is CMYK 100/92.5/19.2/5.9 (the most drifted blue), aqua CMYK 67.8/3.1/19.2/0; the template uses the tokens #1A3580 and #32B9CD.
